title: Passport Beep Bop
style: Electronic pop instrumental with bouncy mid-tempo syncopation and playful four-on-the-floor pulse; verse cycles through a toy-synth motif, pre-drop strips to handclaps and filtered bass, chorus opens with bright marimba-like plucks and a wide brass stab hook. Use quick risers, globe-spinning whooshes, reverse swells, and tiny chime fills between phrases. Crisp, glossy mix with punchy low end and sparkling top., world
